name: Anatolian
notes: Classification-only clade node for the Anatolian branch of Indo-European (Hittite, Luwian, Palaic, Lydian, Lycian, Carian). Carries no phonology: it is never a data-inheritance source, only a step in the ancestry chain from which `family` is derived. Anatolian is the earliest-attested branch to split from Proto-Indo-European.
